findings: Whole nameTools source read in four bounded nontruncated ranges. Module initialization creates database-backed name maps and shared directory proxy; it was not imported or run as a module.

Original getDirDict with identity canonical-name adapter normalizes Report.1 and Report1 into report1, prints a collision warning and retains only Report1. Real owned directories confirm overwrite. This is fuzzy name lookup policy, not proof of content identity.

Original DirNameProxy membership on whitespace-only key returns a nonempty dictionary, which Python treats asTrue even though __getitem__ returns fqPathNone. Native selected class/function control confirms empty membership mismatch.

Forced refresh of a missing directory raisesValueError while retaining updateLock. A nonblocking probe finds the real owned lock unavailable after the exception. No watcher threads or next blocking acquire attempted.
